llm_response.reason: The website displays an unusually diverse and unrelated product selection at enticing prices, employs urgency and psychological lures, prominently advertises daily updates and free shipping, and provides ambiguous company identification. WHOIS information shows the domain was registered extremely recently with complete privacy protection and no business legitimacy can be confirmed. Only a vague contact link is provided with no professional phone or email. These are hallmark features of a Fake Online Shopping scam.
